evidence: Both the upper observation cabin (rows 8-17) and lower base structure (rows 51-61) clearly show foreshortened top roof surfaces in lighter steel-blue tones, bordered by lighter front-edge highlights (rows 15-16 and 61), eave shadows underneath (rows 17 and 62-63), and recessed windows/doors on the vertical front faces.
